commit.message: Use jarvice-db secret for database passwords..

A new mysql container image was released for 5.6.  Let's stick with what
we know works already.
Set JARVICE_IMAGES_TAG to jarvice-master for master branch..
support for syncing only user-owned applications (set jarvice.JARVICE_APPSYNC_USERONLY=true); default is still to sync all apps authorized by container (including public) to the remote user

Add JARVICE_SYSTEM_K8S for jarvice system pods, add tolerations support,
tweak tls for jarvice-registry..
Fix mail conf settings, node role examples..
oops..  Accidentally removed a couple lines..
Fix pod scheduler probes, remove extraneous items in values.yaml..
jobs ingress and pod scheduler additions
A bunch of updates for secrets and keys..
ingress controller parameter for jobs, and documentation
Update secret.. Need to fix this in a more general sense..
Add pod disruption budgets for base jarvice deployments/services
Add robustness, use antiAffinity with other deployments..
Add antiAffinity and PodDisruptionBudget for memcached..
We know mysql:5.6 works, use that..
support optional k8s pod scheduler selection using ${JARVICE_SCHED_PODSCHED}

Add deployment-date annotation so that helm upgrades always do a rolling
restart.  Add JARVICE_BUILD_NODE_SELECTOR for jarvice-api..
Add jarvice-deploy2eks with doco. Other miscellaneous updates.
Give memcached a little more resources..
jarvice-appsync related updates and more cleanups..

Break out secrets from settings.  Remove more unecessary pre-install
hooks..
Remove unnecessary pre hooks.  Fixup serviceaccount naming.
Mostly configmap volume related updates for jarvice-settings.
Add StatefulSet for memcached..  Other tweaks..
Don't create the custom cluterRole by default..
Allow config of hostNetwork for the DAL..
Updates for multi-arch, role bindings, and node selectors..
